video_title: Kevin Durant CLAPS BACK but is he the one to BLAME for Phoenix 👀

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kevin Durant was not the problem for the Phoenix Suns
quotes.excerpt: Kevin Durant was not your problem. It was far from the problem.
quotes.quote: Kevin Durant was not your problem. It was far from the problem. Everyone in America saw what your problem was and guess what? You still have it.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Phoenix Suns were better with Drew Eubanks as center
quotes.excerpt: They had Drew Eubanks the year before as a starting center.

text_blocks.speaker: Theo Pinson
text_blocks.text: They had Drew Eubanks the year before as a starting center.

text_blocks.speaker: Charlie Villanueva
text_blocks.text: He's out the league too, by the way.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Luka Doncic is a point guard who gets everyone involved
quotes.excerpt: Luka is a point guard. He can actually get everyone involved.
quotes.quote: You can't use Luka in them situation because Luka is a point guard. He can actually get everyone involved. LeBron is an anomaly because he's damn near a point guard. AR can create.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Kyrie Irving does not need the ball all the time
quotes.excerpt: Kyrie Irving doesn't need the ball a lot of time. He just wastes his turn.
quotes.quote: Kyrie Irving doesn't need the ball a lot of time. He just wastes his turn because just like with Luka, it's been proven.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Devin Booker is the only true superstar on the Suns
quotes.excerpt: You got one. Devin Booker. When you bring in a LeBron James, when you bring in a Kevin Durant.
quotes.quote: You got one. Devin Booker. When you bring in a LeBron James, when you bring in a Kevin Durant, there's a certain type of... I think that was the majority of the issue. When you are Devin Booker or Bradley Beal, you got Kevin Durant on your team, that's a guy that's superior to you. So you're like, damn, I got to show proper respect.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: No one on the Suns works harder than Kevin Durant
quotes.excerpt: There's not one person on that team that works harder than Kevin Durant.
quotes.quote: There's not one person on that team that works harder than Kevin Durant. To this day.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Trading for Kyrie Irving or Fred VanVleet would change the Suns
quotes.excerpt: If you keep stuff kind of similar but you bring Kyrie or Fred, I think that changes your team.
quotes.quote: If you keep stuff kind of similar but you bring Kyrie or Fred, I think that changes your team drastically. Fred is a very good starting point guard. He's not an elite starting point guard.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: Ja Morant is a superstar player
quotes.excerpt: If we know Ja Morant to be who Ja Morant is, Devin Booker is Desmond Bane on steroids.
quotes.quote: If we know Ja Morant to be who Ja Morant is, Devin Booker is Desmond Bane on steroids.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Portland Trail Blazers will be a good team
quotes.excerpt: Portland will be good. Like, that's a team that you probably don't want to play.
quotes.quote: Portland will be good. Like, that's a team that you probably don't want to play.

quotes.speaker: Theo Pinson
quotes.summary_phrase: The Western Conference is very tough this year
quotes.excerpt: The West is tough this year, bro.
quotes.quote: The West is tough this year, bro.
